text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон suffers an injury during
training, so
we go to get it treated.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew... Let's get a move on.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
To training, duh! There's more to
training than
running.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
If I can't work on my legs, I'll work my
arms and
back! I can't start slacking just
'cause I got hurt!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Urk... Ouch.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: You really need to rest up.
Let's take things slow and see how you do.

text_block_list.text:
Why? What's wrong with a bit of
strength
training?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: I don't want to risk your injury getting worse.

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but it's a way bigger risk to not do
any
training!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: I am being patient!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: ...Oh, sorry for yelling at you.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: I'll work on a plan to speed up your recovery.

text_block_list.text:
Okay, thanks. I'll leave that to you and
take it
easy, then.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: All right! Let's head to the gym an—
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Agh!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hish Amazon tips over the moment she
tries to
stand up, but I thankfully
manage to catch her
just in time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ugh! Ouch...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Thanks, Teach. You saved me there.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: Maybe we should hold off on the training.

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm probably gonna make things
worse at
this rate. I'll go home for today
and rest up.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
This is exactly what you wanted from the

beginning, isn't it?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
But you knew I wouldn't have agreed if
you
ordered me to rest...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
All right. I'll take some time off till my
body's
back to normal!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: All right! Let's head to the gym an—
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I get it. I'm trying not to put any
strain on
my legs.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Geez, there's only so much training I can
do like
this.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: Leave the training regimen to me.

text_block_list.text:
As if you'd let me train on my own terms,
eh?
Well, that's fine by me.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You're the one who's compromising with
me
despite how unreasonable I'm being,
so I promise
I won't push myself!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон trains around her injury
and makes
a quick recovery.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон stays true to her word and
rests
until her injury is fully healed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон rests until her leg pain
wears off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
